Coram : ARUN MISHRA*, S. ABDUL NAZEER
. Limitation Act, 1963 -Art. 65 Explanation (b) -Applicability- B Held: Art. 65 Explanation (b) is not applicable to a heir of Hindu C or Mohammedan female who is full owner of the property as it could not .be said that the person became entitled to fhe right of the female but derives right through her - Suit by such a heir is not governed by Art. 65 Explanation (b) - On facts, property was claimed from a Hindu woman-SB, who was D fall owner, on her death in 1962 - It could not be said that AB-heir of such female or the plaintiffs became entitled
Decision Date : 25-04-2017 | Case No : CIVIL APPEAL No. 3110/2012 | Disposal Nature : Dismissed | Bench : 2 Judges
